name: Cameco Corporation
blurb: Cameco Corporation is a leading global provider of uranium fuel for nuclear power generation, operating through three segments: Uranium, Fuel Services, and Westinghouse. The Uranium segment explores, mines, and sells uranium concentrate; Fuel Services handles refining, conversion, and fabrication; and Westinghouse is a nuclear reactor technology OEM. Headquartered in Canada, Cameco is one of the world's largest uranium producers and plays a critical role in the nuclear energy supply chain.
recent: In the past 30 days, Cameco reported strong earnings on May 5, 2026, with net income surging 161.6% year-over-year to $466.07 million. The stock has traded in a 52-week range of $48.81 to $135.24, closing at $116.75 on May 8, 2026. Analysts maintain a Strong Buy rating with a price target of $123.92, reflecting optimism around nuclear energy demand.
